**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The agreement contains no minimum purchase commitment, take-or-pay, shortfall penalty, or volume restriction on us:

- **§11 Fees (p0084)** — we pay only "the fees as set out in the Fee Schedule," i.e. for the licence and services actually ordered.
- **§10 Maintenance (p0065)** — maintenance runs "[f]or a renewable one-year term," not a locked multi-year commitment.
- **§17(b) (p0118)** — we may terminate at any time on 90 days' notice, so even the annual maintenance term carries an exit.
- **§3** contains only standard use restrictions (copying, reverse engineering, sublicensing), not caps on our purchase or usage volumes.

Searches for "minimum," "commit," "take or pay," and "shortfall" surfaced nothing relevant — the sole "commitment" hit is the no-agency clause. This sits at the **preferred** position under MINCOMMIT.
